subject: Urgent: Ridgeview production latency & error spike after v4.3 upgrade
messages:
From: Sarah Johnson <sarah.johnson@ridgeview.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Ridgeview Platform <infra@ridgeview.com>, Mike Lee <mike.lee@ridgeview.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Production latency spike after v4.3 rollout

Naomi —

We rolled your v4.3 model / q2-8 quantization profile into our production traffic during the 04:00 UTC window and immediately saw a regression: p95 latency ~x2, p99 ~x3, and a sustained ~1.8% 500 error increase across the hot path. Throughput dropped ~25% vs baseline. Attached are a sample of request/response traces and our Nginx access logs (logs.zip).

This is impacting our clinician-facing workflow; requests are timing out and a subset of responses are truncated. Can you confirm whether Redwood pushed any model swaps or quantization profile changes this morning? We need an ETA for rollback or mitigation.

Attaching: logs.zip

— Sarah
Sarah Johnson
Head of Platform Engineering, Ridgeview Health
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Johnson <sarah.johnson@ridgeview.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production latency spike after v4.3 rollout

Sarah — thanks for the heads up and for the logs. I’m escalating now and we’ll treat this as an urgent production incident.

Immediate next steps (we will execute these unless you instruct otherwise):
- Pause any automated rollouts for Ridgeview (I’ve put the tenant in paused state).
- Begin emergency rollback to v4.2 + q1-7 fallback profile (expected ~35–45 min).
- Engineering will triage the attached traces and confirm root cause; we’ll share a short postmortem within 24 hours.

Can you confirm you’re OK with the rollback? We want to make sure we don’t interfere with any internal change windows you already have open.

I’m looping Marcus & Monica for ETA and runbook.

— Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Johnson <sarah.johnson@ridgeview.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Ridgeview production spike — immediate rollback request 

Team — Ridgeview reported significant p99 latency and ~1.8% 500s after our v4.3 + q2-8 rollout (see Sarah’s email and attached logs.zip). They are a clinical-facing customer; impact is user-visible.

Please prioritize:
1) Confirm whether any model variant routing or kernel selection changes were applied to their cluster at 04:00 UTC.
2) If root cause is unclear within 20 minutes, perform emergency rollback to v4.2 + q1-7 fallback (per Naomi’s note).
3) Gather quant/trace artifacts and push a short summary to INC-7821 (link below).

I’ve created INC-7821 and linked the HubSpot account. Marcus, can you own rollback? Dylan, can you collect the profiling captures (KV cache hit/miss, kernel selection log, sequence length distribution)? Monica, please prep a customer-facing note with expected timeline and post-rollback validation checklist.

Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-7821
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

Thanks — Naomi
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Ridgeview production spike — immediate rollback request

Quick update after initial triage:
- Reproduced increased latency in canary env when applying q2-8 profile to the v4.3 checkpoint with the same prompt distribution Ridgeview sent.
- Root cause hypothesis: q2-8 introduces more aggressive weight packing that pushes certain attention kernels down a slower code path on our current TPU/GPU mix for their cluster; we’re seeing higher KV cache churn and worse memory access patterns for hot sequences. That explains both p99 and throughput drop.

Attachments: latency_report.csv (p50/p95/p99 delta by timestamp), fallback_config.yaml (rollback commands + config to pin v4.2 + q1-7).

Plan:
- Rollback to v4.2 + q1-7 now (Dylan will execute). Estimated 35 min to complete rollback and traffic ramp back up; 120 min to monitor for stability.
- After rollback, we’ll run a controlled re-test of q2-8 in an isolated pool with larger batch sizes to validate kernel path behavior and memory patterns.

I’ll push detailed notes to INC-7821.

— Marcus
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Johnson <sarah.johnson@ridgeview.com>, Mike Lee <mike.lee@ridgeview.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production latency spike after v4.3 rollout — rollback scheduled at 10:20 PT

Sarah / Mike —

Thanks for the quick flag. We have a rollback scheduled and will start at 10:20 PT (10:20 Pacific / 17:20 UTC). Expected timeline: ~35–45 minutes for rollback, then 2 hours of verification. We will notify you the moment p99 returns to baseline.

Attachment: rollback_plan.pdf (high-level rollback steps and validation checklist).

If you have any queued internal changes, please pause them for the next 3 hours. We’ll send continuous updates to this thread and to your infra channel.

— Naomi
From: Sarah Johnson <sarah.johnson@ridgeview.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Ridgeview Platform <infra@ridgeview.com>, Mike Lee <mike.lee@ridgeview.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production latency spike after v4.3 rollout — rollback scheduled at 10:20 PT

Naomi / team — thanks. We approve the rollback. Please share a confirmation when complete and a short summary of the cause + mitigation once you have it.

— Sarah

[Follow-up on Wed 5 Aug 2026]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Johnson <sarah.johnson@ridgeview.com>, Mike Lee <mike.lee@ridgeview.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Ridgeview — rollback complete and post-rollback metrics

Sarah / Mike —

Rollback to v4.2 + q1-7 completed at 10:46 PT on Mon, Aug 3. Post-rollback monitoring shows p99 latency back within 5% of baseline and 500 errors returned to baseline ~30 minutes after traffic ramp. We’ve attached the post-rollback metric screenshot (post_rollback_metrics.png) and uploaded an expanded latency delta CSV to the Jira ticket.

Root cause (interim): quantization profile q2-8 interacts poorly with the kernel selection logic for sequences with long prefix KV usage on Ridgeview’s workload; that produced worse cache locality and forced slower kernels under load. Engineering will follow up with a full postmortem and a safe path to revalidate q2-8 in an isolated cluster.

Next steps:
- Marcus/Dylan: full postmortem and remediation plan to INC-7821 by EOD Thu.
- Monica: coordinate a technical readout with Ridgeview to walk the postmortem and agree on safe testing windows.

Thanks for the fast coordination. Let us know if you want an exec-level summary — happy to set a 30-min call.

— Naomi
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
